Police stop YS Sharmila from entering Bengaluru property amid dispute

Bengaluru police prevented YS Sharmila, Andhra Pradesh Congress chief, from entering a property identified as 'Yelahanka Palace' on Tuesday. Authorities cited a court order as the reason for stopping her. The incident occurred amidst a deepening property dispute concerning the palace.
